versions.changelog:
- Added .gitignore file to the repository.
- Updated documentation: changed API base URL default from `https://api.dscvr.one` to `https://dscvr.one`.
- Adjusted the default `--limit` value for the "Get Event List" tool from 20 to 10.
- Minor clarification in smart money trader search: `--keyword` now described as "Fuzzy search by name or bio".
- No changes to skill functionality; version bump is for documentation and housekeeping only.

Initial release of the dscvr-skills package for querying DSCVR crypto intelligence APIs.

- Enables querying DSCVR APIs for market news, event tracking, smart money analysis, prediction market data, and AI-powered discovery.
- Provides command-line tools for retrieving event categories, detailed event data, smart money traders, prediction markets, and social graph data via GraphQL.
- Authenticates all API requests using HMAC-SHA256 signing.
- Requires Python 3.10+, uv, and valid DSCVR API credentials.
- Supports rich filtering, pagination, and configurable parameters for in-depth crypto intelligence data access.
